kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتعاطف (form VI)
# نَتَعَاطَفُ (nataʕāṭafu) /na.ta.ʕaː.tˤa.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَاطَفَ (taʕāṭafa)
# نَتَعَاطَفَ (nataʕāṭafa) /na.ta.ʕaː.tˤa.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاطَفَ (taʕāṭafa)
# نَتَعَاطَفْ (nataʕāṭaf) /na.ta.ʕaː.tˤaf/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَاطَفَ (taʕāṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
